# Worth the Fee

> Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you. Each page answers one question in its first two sentences, cites its sources and gives the date it was checked. Some pages end with a disclosed referral link.

## Amex Platinum

- [What does the Amex Platinum $200 airline fee credit actually cover?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-airline-fee-credit-what-counts/): Extra fees such as checked bags and seat selection on one airline you pick in advance, up to $200 a year. It does not cover tickets or upgrades.
- [When is the Amex Platinum annual fee charged, and can you get it refunded?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-annual-fee-when-charged-and-refund/): The $895 fee is reported to post on the first statement. Amex refunds it only if you close within 30 days after that statement's closing date.
- [What credit score and income do you need for the Amex Platinum?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-approval-requirements/): Amex publishes no minimum score or income. Guides suggest good to excellent credit, and Amex can show a decision before any hard inquiry.
- [Is adding an authorized user to the Amex Platinum worth $195?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-authorized-user-worth-195/): It pays off for a partner who flies with you about four times a year or wants lounge access alone. It adds no second set of statement credits.
- [What does Amex Platinum cell phone protection cover, and what is the deductible?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-cell-phone-protection/): Amex Platinum covers a stolen or damaged phone up to $800 per claim after a $50 deductible, twice a year, if the phone bill is paid with the card.
- [Can you bring guests into a Centurion Lounge with the Amex Platinum, and what does it cost?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-centurion-lounge-guest-rules/): Yes, up to two guests on your flight, at $50 per adult and $30 per child. Guests are free only after $75,000 of card spending in a year.
- [What are the Amex Platinum credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-credits-real-value/): On paper the 11 main Amex Platinum credits total $2,994 a year. Your real number is only the ones you would have paid for anyway.
- [How many Delta Sky Club visits does the Amex Platinum give, and what are the rules?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-delta-sky-club-visits/): Ten visits a year, February 1 to January 31, only with a same-day Delta flight that is not basic economy. Guests and extra visits cost $50 each.
- [Which subscriptions count for the Amex Platinum digital entertainment credit?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-digital-entertainment-credit-what-counts/): Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, Paramount+, Peacock, YouTube Premium, YouTube TV, The New York Times and The Wall Street Journal, billed directly.
- [If the Amex Platinum fee stops being worth it, what are the options and what happens to the points?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-downgrade-or-cancel-options/): You can ask for a retention offer, downgrade to Gold ($325) or Green ($150), or cancel. Points survive only if another Membership Rewards card stays open.
- [American Express Platinum golf benefits: what does the card do for golfers?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-for-golfers/): The US American Express Platinum has no free rounds, green fee credit or tee time priority. Its hotel credit and lounges can help a golf trip.
- [Does the Amex Platinum charge foreign transaction fees, and how well does it work abroad?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-foreign-transaction-fees-abroad/): The Amex Platinum has no foreign transaction fee, but Amex is taken in fewer places abroad than Visa or Mastercard, and cash from an ATM is costly.
- [How do the Amex Platinum Global Entry, TSA PreCheck and CLEAR credits work, and what are they worth?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-global-entry-clear-credit/): Amex Platinum refunds a Global Entry ($120) or TSA PreCheck fee about every four years, and up to $219 a year for CLEAR+, when charged to the card.
- [What does the Amex Platinum actually do for one Hawaii trip a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-hawaii-trip/): One Hawaii trip gets up to $300 back on a prepaid hotel stay and lounge access in Honolulu and Maui. Kona and Lihue have no lounge the card opens.
- [How does the Amex Platinum hotel credit work?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-hotel-credit-how-it-works/): Up to $300 back each half-year, $600 a year, on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts, Hotel Collection or Airbnb Luxe stays booked through Amex Travel.
- [What do the Marriott Gold and Hilton Gold status from Amex Platinum actually get you?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-hotel-status-marriott-hilton-gold/): Hilton Gold gives a daily food credit or breakfast and 80% bonus points. Marriott Gold gives 25% bonus points and 2 p.m. checkout, with no breakfast.
- [How does the Amex Platinum Lululemon credit work, and what counts?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-lululemon-credit-how-it-works/): Up to $75 back each quarter, $300 a year, at US lululemon stores and lululemon.com after you enroll. Outlets and gift cards are excluded.
- [What are the Amex Platinum Oura and Equinox credits worth if you would not buy them anyway?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-oura-and-equinox-credits/): Close to $0. The $200 Oura credit still leaves about $149 to pay for a ring, and the $300 Equinox credit covers only an app or part of a gym fee.
- [Is the Amex Platinum a charge card or a credit card, and how does Pay Over Time work?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-pay-over-time-how-it-works/): It works like a charge card with no preset limit, plus a Pay Over Time feature that lets eligible charges carry a balance with interest.
- [How do Amex Platinum purchase protection, return protection and extended warranty work?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-purchase-protection-return-protection/): Amex Platinum covers new items for 90 days up to $10,000, refunds refused returns up to $300 an item, and adds up to a year of warranty.
- [Is the Amex Platinum referral offer higher or lower than the public offer?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-referral-vs-public-offer/): It can be higher, lower or the same. Amex sets an offer for each applicant, so compare the number each route shows you before you accept.
- [What rental car status and insurance come with the Amex Platinum?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-rental-car-status-and-insurance/): Status with Hertz, Avis and National after enrolling, plus secondary damage cover up to $75,000. A paid add-on makes the cover primary.
- [How does the Amex Platinum Resy credit work, and can you use it without living in a big city?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-resy-credit-how-it-works/): You enroll once, pay at an eligible US Resy restaurant, and get up to $100 back each quarter. No booking is needed, but small towns may have none.
- [What travel insurance does the Amex Platinum include, and what does it leave out?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-trip-delay-cancellation-insurance/): Amex Platinum covers trip delay up to $500, trip cancellation up to $10,000 and lost bags up to $3,000 a person. It does not pay medical bills.
- [Is the Amex Platinum Uber credit worth anything if you rarely take Uber?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-uber-credit-worth-it/): Yes, if you order from Uber Eats now and then. The $15 a month works on food orders too, but it expires every month and cannot be saved up.
- [Amex Platinum or Amex Gold: which fits someone who travels a few times a year but eats out every week?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-gold-which-fits/): For weekly restaurant spending and a few trips, the Gold fits better: 4 points per dollar on dining and a $325 fee, against 1 point and $895.
- [Amex Platinum or Chase Sapphire Reserve for a once-a-year Hawaii trip?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-sapphire-reserve-hawaii/): For one Hawaii trip a year the Sapphire Reserve fits better: lower fee, a simple $300 travel credit and 1:1 Hyatt transfers.
- [How does the Amex Platinum Walmart+ credit work, and is the membership worth having?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-walmart-plus-credit-how-it-works/): The card refunds a monthly Walmart+ membership, $12.95 plus tax, up to $155 a year. The annual plan earns no credit. Worth having if you use it.
- [What counts toward the Amex Platinum welcome-offer spending requirement, and what does not?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-welcome-offer-spending-requirement/): Purchases of goods and services count. The annual fee, gift cards, prepaid cards, person-to-person payments and cash equivalents do not.
- [Is the Amex Platinum worth its annual fee if you only fly 4 to 6 times a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-worth-it-occasional-flyer/): Usually only if you would use about $900 of its credits anyway. At 4 to 6 flights a year, the lounges alone do not cover the $895 fee.
- [How do Amex referral offers work, and why does the page say "as high as" a number?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-referral-offer-how-it-works/): An Amex referral link opens an application where Amex shows your own offer before you accept. "As high as" is the top figure, not a promise.
- [Are credit card welcome bonuses and referral bonuses taxable in the US?](https://itsworththefee.com/are-credit-card-welcome-bonuses-taxable/): Welcome bonuses earned by spending are generally treated as rebates, not income. Referral bonuses are generally taxable and can be reported on a 1099.
- [Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection: which uses the Amex Platinum hotel credit better?](https://itsworththefee.com/fine-hotels-resorts-vs-hotel-collection/): The Hotel Collection is usually cheaper, so $300 covers more of the bill. Fine Hotels + Resorts adds breakfast and a guaranteed late checkout.
- [How do you check which Amex Platinum welcome offer you are shown, and why do people see different numbers?](https://itsworththefee.com/highest-amex-platinum-welcome-offer-how-to-check/): Amex shows your own Platinum offer during the application, before you accept. Numbers differ because Amex sets the offer for each applicant.

## Chase Sapphire

- [What is Chase's 5/24 rule, and how do you count your cards?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-5-24-rule-explained/): Chase generally declines applicants who opened five or more personal credit cards, at any bank, in the past 24 months. Here is what counts.
- [What is Chase Points Boost, and how much are Chase points worth now?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-points-boost-explained/): Chase points are worth 1 cent each in Chase Travel, or up to 2 cents on selected Points Boost bookings. The old fixed 1.25 and 1.5 cent rates are ending.
- [What does an authorized user cost on the Sapphire Preferred and the Reserve, and what do they get?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-authorized-user-cost-and-benefits/): Authorized users are free on the Sapphire Preferred and $195 a year each on the Reserve, where they get their own lounge access but no extra credits.
- [Can you get a Sapphire welcome bonus if you had a Sapphire card before? The 2026 rules](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-bonus-eligibility-2026/): You can earn each Sapphire card's bonus once in your life. Having had the other Sapphire card no longer blocks you, as of January 2026.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit: how it works and what bookings count](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-50-hotel-credit-how-it-works/): The Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit is up to $100 per account year, up from $50 in June 2026, for prepaid stays booked through Chase Travel.
- [How does the Sapphire Preferred 10% anniversary points bonus work?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-anniversary-points-bonus/): The Sapphire Preferred's 10% anniversary points bonus ended in 2026. Final bonuses are due by January 31, 2027. Here is what replaced it.
- [What credit score do you need for the Chase Sapphire Preferred?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-credit-score-needed/): Chase publishes no minimum score for the Sapphire Preferred. Named sources report 670 to 700 and up, and the score is only one of several checks.
- [What DoorDash and DashPass benefits come with the Sapphire Preferred, and what are they worth?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-doordash-dashpass-benefit/): The Sapphire Preferred includes free DashPass through 2029 and $10 a month off one non-restaurant DoorDash order. It is worth $0 to non-users.
- [Is the Chase Sapphire Preferred a sensible first travel card, and what credit do you need?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-first-travel-card/): It suits a first travel card if you have good credit, about a year or more of history, and travel enough to use a $95 card. Chase sets no minimum score.
- [What should you do in the first year with a Sapphire Preferred to get your $95 back?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-first-year-plan/): One hotel stay booked through Chase Travel returns up to $100, which covers the $95 fee. The rest of the first-year checklist is extra.
- [Can Chase Sapphire Preferred points pay for a Disney trip, and how far do they go?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-for-disney-trip/): Sapphire Preferred points can cover flights and hotels near the Disney parks. US park tickets are the hard part and usually get 1 cent a point.
- [Is the Chase Sapphire Preferred a good card to use abroad?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-foreign-transaction-fees-abroad/): The Sapphire Preferred has no foreign transaction fee and runs on Visa. Cash withdrawals are costly, and it does not pay medical bills abroad.
- [Is the Chase Sapphire Preferred worth it if you take one big trip a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-one-trip-a-year/): Usually yes: one hotel booking through Chase Travel returns $100 against the $95 fee, but only if you would book that way anyway.
- [How do purchase protection and extended warranty work on the Chase Sapphire Preferred?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-purchase-protection-extended-warranty/): Purchase protection covers theft or damage for 120 days, up to $500 per item. Extended warranty adds one year to a warranty of three years or less.
- [How does a Chase Sapphire refer-a-friend link work for the person applying?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-referral-bonus-how-it-works/): A Sapphire referral link opens a normal Chase application with its own stated offer. Chase's usual approval and bonus rules still apply to you.
- [Does the Chase Sapphire Preferred cover a rental car, and what does primary coverage leave out?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-rental-car-insurance/): The Sapphire Preferred covers theft and damage to the rental car itself, up to $60,000. It does not cover liability, injuries or your belongings.
- [What travel insurance comes with the Sapphire Preferred, and what does it not cover?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-travel-insurance/): The Sapphire Preferred covers trip cancellation, delays, bags and rental car damage, but not medical bills abroad or a simple change of plans.
- [Does pairing a Sapphire Preferred with Freedom cards make sense, and how do you combine the points?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-with-freedom-cards-combine-points/): Pairing works if you transfer points to partners: Freedom points move to the Preferred free and at once. Since 2025 it no longer lifts portal value.
- [Is the Chase Sapphire referral offer the same as the public or in-branch offer?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-referral-vs-public-offer/): On November 20, 2026 the referral and public Sapphire Preferred offers matched. They have differed before, and branch offers were not confirmed.
- [What counts toward the Chase Sapphire Reserve's $300 travel credit, and when does it reset?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-300-travel-credit-what-counts/): Any purchase Chase codes as travel counts, from flights to tolls and parking. It resets each account anniversary year and earns no points.
- [What are the Sapphire Reserve credits really worth if you only count the ones you would use anyway?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-credits-real-value/): The Reserve lists about $2,400 a year in credits, but most people would use $300 to $900 of it. Add up your own number against the $795 fee.
- [How does the Sapphire Reserve dining credit (Exclusive Tables) work, and which restaurants count?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-dining-credit-how-it-works/): The Reserve pays back up to $150 per half-year at a set list of a few hundred restaurants on OpenTable. Check your city before counting it.
- [Which airport lounges does the Sapphire Reserve get you into, and what are the guest rules?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-lounge-access/): The Sapphire Reserve covers Chase Sapphire Lounges at eight US airports and 1,300+ Priority Pass lounges, with two guests free. Restaurants are out.
- [How does the Chase Sapphire Reserve StubHub credit work, and what counts?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-stubhub-credit-how-it-works/): The Reserve pays back up to $150 per half-year on StubHub and viagogo tickets through 2027, after a one-time activation. Unused credit does not roll over.
- [How does the Sapphire Reserve credit for The Edit hotels work, and what are the catches?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-the-edit-credit-how-it-works/): The Reserve gives up to $250 back on each of two prepaid stays of two nights or more at The Edit hotels per calendar year. Most cost far more.
- [Can you upgrade a Sapphire Preferred to a Reserve or downgrade to a Freedom card, and what happens to points and the bonus?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-upgrade-downgrade-product-change/): Yes, after about a year with the card. A product change keeps the account but pays no welcome bonus, and a Freedom card cannot transfer points.
- [What counts toward the Chase Sapphire welcome-bonus spending requirement, and when do the points post?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-welcome-bonus-spending-requirement/): Purchases by you or an authorized user count. Fees, balance transfers, cash advances and cash-like transactions do not. Allow 6 to 8 weeks.
- [Did Chase change the Hyatt transfer rate, and which Sapphire card still transfers 1:1?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-to-hyatt-transfer-change-2026/): Yes. Since October 1, 2026 the Sapphire Preferred sends 4 Chase points for 3 Hyatt points. The Sapphire Reserve still transfers 1:1.
- [How much does applying for a travel card affect your credit score, and for how long?](https://itsworththefee.com/does-applying-for-a-travel-card-hurt-credit-score/): One application usually costs fewer than five FICO points. The inquiry counts for 12 months and stays on your credit report for two years.
- [Sapphire Preferred or Sapphire Reserve for someone who travels two or three times a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/sapphire-preferred-vs-reserve-light-traveler/): For two or three trips a year the $95 Preferred fits most people; the $795 Reserve pays off only if you use several of its credits.

## Other Amex cards

- [Blue Cash Preferred or Blue Cash Everyday: at what grocery spend does the annual fee pay off?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-blue-cash-preferred-vs-everyday/): The Blue Cash Preferred's $95 fee pays off above about $3,167 a year in US supermarket spending, roughly $264 a month, compared with the Everyday.
- [Is the Amex Gold Card worth its annual fee if you cook at home most nights?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-gold-card-worth-the-fee/): At $325 a year, the Gold Card pays off for a home cook only with about $8,125 of yearly grocery spend, or less if you use its monthly credits.
- [Does the Amex Gold Card have cell phone protection?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-gold-cell-phone-protection/): No. The consumer Amex Gold Card is not on Amex's list of cards with cell phone protection. It has 90-day purchase protection instead.
- [What is an Amex Membership Rewards point actually worth?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-membership-rewards-points-value/): A Membership Rewards point is worth about 0.6 cents as a statement credit, 1 cent on Amex Travel flights, and often more with transfer partners.
- [What is the Amex "once per lifetime" welcome offer rule, and how do you know if you are still eligible?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-once-per-lifetime-welcome-offer-rule/): Amex generally gives a welcome offer once per card per person. A notice during the application tells you if you are not eligible before you commit.
- [Delta SkyMiles Gold, Platinum or Reserve Amex: which one fits someone who flies Delta 4 to 8 times a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/delta-gold-vs-platinum-vs-reserve-amex/): At 4 to 8 Delta flights a year, Gold fits bag-checkers, Platinum fits pairs who will use the companion certificate, and Reserve is for lounge users.
- [How many Delta flights does it take for the SkyMiles Gold Amex checked-bag benefit to cover the annual fee?](https://itsworththefee.com/delta-skymiles-gold-amex-free-checked-bag-math/): With Delta's first bag at $45 each way, four one-way flights with a checked bag (two round trips) cover the Gold card's $150 annual fee.
- [Hilton Honors Surpass or Aspire: which Amex is worth it for two or three Hilton stays a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/hilton-surpass-vs-aspire-amex/): For two or three Hilton stays a year, the $150 Surpass is easier to earn back; the $550 Aspire needs its free night and resort credits to be used.
- [Is the Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Amex worth its annual fee for an occasional Marriott guest?](https://itsworththefee.com/marriott-bonvoy-brilliant-amex-worth-650/): The $650 fee can be earned back with the $300 dining credit and one free night worth $350 or more, but status adds little on a few stays a year.

## Rakuten

- [Does Rakuten give cash back on Amazon?](https://itsworththefee.com/does-rakuten-work-on-amazon/): Not as a regular percentage. On November 21, 2026 Rakuten listed only $5 on each of a new member's first three Amazon orders.
- [How does Rakuten work, step by step?](https://itsworththefee.com/how-does-rakuten-work-step-by-step/): You click through Rakuten to a store and buy. The store pays Rakuten a commission, and Rakuten passes part of it to you four times a year.
- [Is Ebates now Rakuten?](https://itsworththefee.com/is-ebates-now-rakuten/): Yes. Ebates was bought by Rakuten in 2014 and took the Rakuten name in 2019. Accounts, balances and the way cash back works carried over.
- [Is Rakuten cash back taxable, and what about the referral bonus?](https://itsworththefee.com/is-rakuten-cash-back-taxable/): Cash back on your own purchases is generally treated as a rebate, not income. Referral bonuses can be taxable and may be reported.
- [Is Rakuten free to join and use, and what is the catch?](https://itsworththefee.com/is-rakuten-free/): Yes, Rakuten is free: no fee to join or shop. One fee can apply after 12 idle months, and payment waits for a quarterly date and a $5 minimum.
- [Is Rakuten legit, and how does it make money if it pays you?](https://itsworththefee.com/is-rakuten-legit-how-it-makes-money/): Yes. Stores pay Rakuten a commission for sending shoppers, and Rakuten shares part of it with you. The trade is your shopping data.
- [Rakuten sign-up bonus and referral bonus: how each works, what to spend, and what makes it fail](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-50-bonus-how-it-works/): Read November 25, 2026: join by a member's link, then make $50 of purchases that earn cash back within 90 days. One bonus per person; offers change.
- [Rakuten Academy Sports cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-academy-sports-cash-back-how-it-works/): 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Clearance and sale items, Hot Deals, firearms, ammunition and gift cards earn nothing.
- [Rakuten Ace Hardware cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-ace-hardware-cash-back-how-it-works/): Up to 6% on November 25, 2026, raised from 2%; snow equipment earns 3%. Delivery, assembly and gift cards earn nothing.
- [Rakuten Adidas cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-adidas-cash-back-how-it-works/): Yes: up to 6% on November 21, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Samba, Gazelle, Spezial and EVO SL earn 2%. Collaborations and gift cards earn nothing.
- [Can you get Amex points from Rakuten instead of cash, and is it worth switching?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-amex-points-instead-of-cash/): Yes: Rakuten pays 1 Amex Membership Rewards point per cent of cash back. It is worth it only if you use points for more than 1 cent.
- [Are Amex points from Rakuten worth more than the cash?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-amex-points-worth-more-than-cash/): Only if you use each point for more than 1 cent. Transfers and some flights clear that bar; statement credits and shopping do not.
- [Rakuten app or browser extension: which tracks purchases more reliably?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-app-vs-browser-extension/): No published figures compare them. Rakuten's own guidance is the extension on a computer and the app on a phone. Each fails in different ways.
- [Rakuten Apple cash back: is Apple on Rakuten, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-apple-cash-back-how-it-works/): Yes, Apple is on Rakuten: 2% on November 25, 2026, only on accessories, refurbished items, AppleCare+ and Beats. New iPhones and Macs earn nothing.
- [Rakuten AT&T cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-att-cash-back-how-it-works/): Up to $150 on November 25, 2026, for new AT&T Internet subscribers only, one per member, after 60 days of active service.
- [Rakuten Avis cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-avis-cash-back-how-it-works/): 2.5% on November 25, 2026. Rentals picked up in Alaska or outside the U.S. and Canada, and Avis Worldwide Discount rentals, earn nothing.
- [Rakuten Banana Republic cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-banana-republic-cash-back-how-it-works/): 2% on November 25, 2026, with no raised rate. Gift cards, the Peter Do Collection, Banana Republic Home and the part paid with points earn nothing.
- [Rakuten Best Buy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-best-buy-cash-back-how-it-works/): Rakuten Best Buy cash back was up to 8% by category on November 24, 2026; most items earn 1%. Apple, game consoles and gift cards earn nothing.
- [Rakuten payout: check or PayPal, and what are the dates and minimum?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-big-fat-check-vs-paypal/): Both pay the same amount on the same four dates from about $5. A check is good for 180 days; PayPal needs a valid PayPal email on file.
- [Rakuten Black Friday 2026: does Rakuten do Black Friday, and how the cash back works](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-black-friday-cash-back-2026/): Yes, Rakuten does Black Friday. On November 25, 2026 many stores showed raised cash back, such as 10% at Macy's (was 2%). Rates move daily.
- [Rakuten Bloomingdale's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-bloomingdales-cash-back-how-it-works/): Rakuten's Bloomingdale's page showed 12% (was 2%) on November 25, 2026. Gift cards, phone orders and 5 or more of one item earn nothing.
- [Is the Rakuten browser extension safe, and what data does it collect?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-browser-extension-safe-privacy/): It is Rakuten's own extension, listed in the official browser stores. It records the pages you visit, even when idle; uninstalling stops that.
- [Rakuten Carter's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-carters-cash-back-how-it-works/): 8% on November 25, 2026, marked as raised from 2%. Gift cards earn nothing, US site only, and codes not listed on Rakuten void cash back.
- [Rakuten cash back rates today, by store (November 25)](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-cash-back-rates-today-by-store/): The headline Rakuten cash back rate at 70 large stores, read from Rakuten's store pages on November 25, 2026, with what changed since the last reading.

Rakuten lists raised store rates, but none for the day itself has been published. Earning works as on any day.

- [Rakuten or TopCashback: which pays more, and how do payouts differ?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-vs-topcashback/): Neither pays more at every store. Rakuten pays on four set dates from about $5; TopCashback lets you cash out when cash back is available.

You get one, not both.

- [Rakuten Zappos cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?](https://itsworththefee.com/rakuten-zappos-cash-back-how-it-works/): 2% on November 25, 2026. Birkenstock, VRSNL, gift cards, orders paid with a gift card and Final Sale items over 50% off earn nothing.

## Hawaii & golf trips

- [What is the most practical way to use Amex points for flights to Hawaii?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-points-to-hawaii-best-uses/): Move points to an airline program that books Delta, United or American seats to Hawaii. Amex Travel gives a flat 1 cent per point on flights.
- [What is the most practical way to use Chase points for a Hawaii trip?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-points-to-hawaii-best-uses/): For most people it is flights: move points to United or Southwest, or book through Chase Travel. Hyatt now costs more from a Sapphire Preferred.
- [Is booking a Hawaii resort through Amex Fine Hotels + Resorts worth it?](https://itsworththefee.com/fine-hotels-resorts-hawaii-worth-it/): Often yes for a one- to three-night stay at a resort you already chose, if the rate matches the hotel's. On longer stays the fixed perks matter less.
- [What does it cost to fly with golf clubs on US airlines, and which cards cover the fee?](https://itsworththefee.com/flying-with-golf-clubs-airline-fees/): A golf bag is charged as a normal checked bag: about $45 each way as a first bag, $55 as a second. Some card credits and airline cards cover it.
- [Does credit card travel insurance cover a golf trip?](https://itsworththefee.com/golf-trip-travel-insurance-credit-card/): It can cover a canceled or delayed trip and lost or damaged clubs, within limits. No source shows cover for a rained-out round or lost green fees.
- [Which Hawaii airport lounges can you get into with the Amex Platinum or Sapphire Reserve?](https://itsworththefee.com/hawaii-airport-lounges-by-card/): Both cards open lounges at Honolulu and Maui through Priority Pass. Neither opens a lounge at Kona or Lihue. Platinum adds the Delta Sky Club.
- [For one week in Hawaii, which travel card comes closest to paying for itself?](https://itsworththefee.com/hawaii-trip-which-card-pays-for-itself/): On one trip alone, only the Sapphire Preferred covers its fee. The Sapphire Reserve falls about $245 short and the Amex Platinum about $415.
- [How many points does a Hyatt hotel in Hawaii cost per night?](https://itsworththefee.com/hyatt-hotels-hawaii-points-cost/): From about 12,000 points a night at Hyatt Place Waikiki to 35,000 to 75,000 at Andaz Maui and Grand Hyatt Kauai. Sources conflict on some categories.
- [Do premium credit cards offer golf travel packages as well as tee-time bookings?](https://itsworththefee.com/premium-credit-card-golf-benefits-tee-times-packages/): Mostly tee-time help. Amex Platinum and Sapphire Reserve list no packaged golf trips; Mastercard's Priceless site lists some, sold by a tour operator.

## Card comparisons

- [Amex Gold or Chase Sapphire Preferred for someone who spends most on food?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-gold-vs-chase-sapphire-preferred/): The $325 Gold earns more when supermarket spending is high; the $95 Preferred costs less for someone who mostly eats out.
- [Amex Business Platinum vs personal Platinum: how do the fee and credits differ?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-business-platinum/): Both cost $895 with the same lounges and hotel credit; the personal card's other credits are for consumers, the business card's for company costs.
- [Amex Platinum or Capital One Venture X: which fee is easier to earn back?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-capital-one-venture-x/): The $395 Venture X fee comes back with one travel booking a year; the $895 Platinum fee takes several separate credits used on purpose.
- [Amex Platinum or Chase Sapphire Reserve: which fee is easier to earn back?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-chase-sapphire-reserve/): The Reserve's $300 credit works on any travel, leaving $495 to cover. The $895 Platinum takes several brand-tied credits used on purpose.
- [Amex Platinum or Delta SkyMiles Reserve for a Delta flyer who wants lounge access?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-delta-skymiles-reserve/): For Delta-only flyers the $650 Reserve gives 15 Sky Club visits and free bags; the $895 Platinum gives 10 visits plus lounges on other airlines.
- [Amex Platinum or Hilton Honors Aspire for someone who stays at Hilton?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-platinum-vs-hilton-honors-aspire/): For Hilton stays the $550 Aspire gives more: Diamond status, 14x at Hilton and a free night. The Platinum gives Gold status and airport lounges.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or Amex Green: which mid-fee travel card fits?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-amex-green/): Amex stopped taking Green Card applications in July 2026, so the Preferred is the one open to new applicants. Green remains as a downgrade.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or a Bilt card for a renter?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-bilt/): A Bilt card earns points on rent only when you also spend on it each month. The Preferred earns nothing on rent but has stronger travel cover.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or Capital One Venture: which fits a few trips a year?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-capital-one-venture/): Both cost $95. The Venture earns more on general spending; the Preferred earns more for heavy dining and has stronger trip cover.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or Citi Strata Premier: which $95-class card fits?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-citi-strata-premier/): Both cost $95. The Strata Premier earns more on supermarkets and airfare; the Preferred has stronger trip cover and United, Southwest and Hyatt.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or Freedom Unlimited: is the annual fee worth paying over the no-fee card?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-freedom-unlimited/): The $95 Preferred is worth it for people who travel, spend abroad or transfer points; for plain cash back the no-fee Freedom Unlimited returns more.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or a Southwest Rapid Rewards card for a Southwest flyer?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-southwest-rapid-rewards-priority/): A Southwest card pays for itself through free checked bags and seat selection. The Preferred fits a Southwest flyer who travels light.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or United Explorer for someone who mostly flies United?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-united-explorer/): A United flyer who checks a bag on two round trips a year covers the Explorer's $150 fee. A carry-on traveler gets more from the Preferred.
- [Chase Sapphire Preferred or Wells Fargo Autograph Journey: which $95 card fits?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-preferred-vs-wells-fargo-autograph-journey/): Both cost $95. The Autograph Journey earns more on flights and hotels booked direct; the Preferred has more transfer partners and rental cover.
- [Chase Sapphire Reserve or Capital One Venture X: which premium card costs less to keep?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-vs-capital-one-venture-x/): The Venture X costs less to keep: about $0 a year after its travel credit and miles, against $495 for the Reserve after its travel credit.
- [Chase Sapphire Reserve or Citi Strata Elite: which premium card costs less to keep?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-sapphire-reserve-vs-citi-strata-elite/): The Strata Elite costs $595 against $795, but the Reserve's $300 credit works on any travel. Which is cheaper depends on the credits you use.

## Other cash back sites

- [How does TopCashback work, step by step, for a first purchase?](https://itsworththefee.com/how-does-topcashback-work-step-by-step/): Search for the store on TopCashback, click Get Cash Back, buy as usual. It shows within about 7 days and takes 1 to 3 months to become available.
- [Is TopCashback legit and free, and how does it make money?](https://itsworththefee.com/is-topcashback-legit-how-it-makes-money/): TopCashback is a real cash back site with no fee. It says it passes on 100% of store commissions and earns from store bonuses and ads.
- [TopCashback app: how does it work on iPhone and Android?](https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-app-how-it-works/): The free TopCashback app lets you shop stores, watch your earnings and cash out from a phone. It says cash back can take up to 6 weeks to show.
- [TopCashback browser extension: how does it work and what does it see?](https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-browser-extension-how-it-works/): The free TopCashback extension shows a pop-up on stores that pay cash back. It reads site addresses, not your searches, by its own privacy notice.
- [TopCashback Highest Cash Back Guarantee: how does the 110% match work?](https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-highest-cash-back-guarantee/): If one of seven named sites shows a higher rate the day you buy, TopCashback says it pays 110% of that rate. You must claim within seven days.
- [How does TopCashback pay you, and when can you cash out?](https://itsworththefee.com/topcashback-how-to-cash-out-and-when/): You can cash out any time once cash back is marked available: to a bank, Venmo, PayPal or a gift card. Each store sets how long that takes.

## Using points

- [Are Amex points or Chase points worth more?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-points-vs-chase-points-which-are-worth-more/): Published values are nearly equal, about 2 cents each. Chase points have the higher floor (1 cent vs 0.6); Amex has more airline partners.
- [Which Amex transfer partners are worth using, and which rarely are?](https://itsworththefee.com/amex-transfer-partners-which-are-worth-it/): Avianca, Virgin Atlantic, Aeroplan, Flying Blue, ANA and the Avios programs tend to beat 1 cent. Hilton, Marriott, Choice and Emirates rarely do.
- [Which Chase transfer partners are worth using, and which rarely are?](https://itsworththefee.com/chase-transfer-partners-which-are-worth-it/): Hyatt, Virgin Atlantic, Aeroplan, Flying Blue and the Avios programs tend to beat Chase Travel's 1 cent. Marriott, IHG and Wyndham rarely do.
- [Do Amex and Chase points expire, and what happens if you close the card?](https://itsworththefee.com/do-amex-and-chase-points-expire/): Neither expires while the account stays open. Close the last card that holds the points and they are lost, so move or use them first.
- [How many Amex or Chase points does a round trip to Europe cost?](https://itsworththefee.com/how-many-points-for-a-flight-to-europe/): A round trip to Europe starts near 12,000 to 55,000 points in economy and 81,000 to 120,000 in business, plus taxes that can pass $1,000.
- [How many Amex or Chase points does a round trip to Japan cost?](https://itsworththefee.com/how-many-points-for-a-flight-to-japan/): A round trip to Japan runs about 40,000 to 80,000 points in economy and 100,000 to 120,000 in business at the lowest partner prices, when seats exist.
- [When should you pay with points, and when with cash?](https://itsworththefee.com/points-or-cash-when-to-pay-with-points/): Divide the cash price, less award taxes, by the points needed. Below about 1 cent per point, pay cash; above about 1.7 to 2 cents, points do well.
- [What does Priority Pass include with the Amex Platinum versus the Sapphire Reserve?](https://itsworththefee.com/priority-pass-by-card-what-you-get/): Both give unlimited lounge visits with two free guests and no restaurant credits. Chase enrolls you automatically and adds a few non-lounge extras.
